PROVEN FIELD EXECUTION // CASE STUDY

Private Equity M&A: Identifying $140,000 in Hidden IT Liabilities

The Challenge

A private equity group was 14 days from closing the acquisition of an Orlando engineering firm whose internal IT documentation was sparse and unverified.

Engineering Solution

Steve Cormier performed an intensive 72-hour on-site architectural audit, discovering that primary CAD file servers were five years past warranty, offsite backups had failed silently for six months, and software licenses were under-reported.

Quantified Outcome

Armed with the architectural risk memorandum, the buyer negotiated a $140,000 purchase price reduction and implemented a turnkey modernization plan immediately upon close.
